labels.uniform: Built for identical hardware (every GPU treated as an A100)
labels.roofline: Data-sheet roofline, one efficiency for every GPU
labels.roofline_calibrated: Roofline corrected by measured step times, with admission control
labels.platform: The platform (learned ensemble, margin, fallback, feedback, admission)
labels.with_margin: Platform planning on the ensemble mean + 1 std everywhere
labels.no_fallback: Platform that trusts the ensemble where it is unsure
labels.no_feedback: Platform that ignores measured step times
labels.naive_backfill: Platform that puts training on any free GPU
labels.platform_ilp: Platform placing replicas by integer optimisation (HiGHS) instead of the greedy pass
labels.learned_backfill: Platform whose fine-tuning start/wait policy was learned by policy search
labels.elastic_jobs: Platform that may shard a fine-tuning job over twice the GPUs (or run it on half)
labels.oracle: Knows the true step times (upper bound)
